title: matter: Support network recovery in BLE advertising
description:
New version of Matter Core specification has added another type of BLE
advertisement service data - network recovery mode. This commit adds
support for proper dissection of such payloads. The new device opcode
is defined in section 5.4.2.5.6.

The specification is available at:
https://csa-iot.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/23-27349-009_Matter-1.5-Core-Specification.pdf
